Draws a navigation card with arrival time, time and distance left, a now playing card, and speed, fuel, range, odometer and outside temperature over the live map. Uses the car\'s own readings and applies at the next connection.

Shows a turn arrow with the distance to the turn, the road name and the arrival time on the head-up display, only during a route. The car keeps projecting its own speed and readouts. Applies when you return to the CarPlay screen.
Shows the track, artist, album art and progress top right while the iPhone plays music.

Google Maps already shows its own directions card on the cluster. Turn on to add Di-Connect\'s card as well. CarPlay always shows it. Applies the next time Android Auto connects.
Turn on the car\'s Bluetooth and pair your Android phone first, then choose it here.
Connect Android Auto from the home screen. A phone plugged in by USB connects by cable; otherwise the chosen phone connects wirelessly.
Stops CarPlay and Android Auto, closes the cluster and head-up display, and opens Di-Connect again. Use it if something stops responding.
Choose how the dash cluster looks for each connection. A new choice shows straight away.

Keep the car’s hotspot on 5 GHz (experimental)

The car sometimes sets its hotspot to Both, which can pick 2.4 GHz and make Android Auto stutter. When Di-Connect starts, it opens the car’s hotspot screen for a few seconds and sets AP Band to 5.0 GHz if it is not already. The hotspot restarts if it changes. Needs Di-Connect’s ADB access.
Set the car’s hotspot to 5 GHz now
Checks whether Di-Connect can change the car’s climate: one degree on the driver’s side, or A/C on and off, then reads it back. Use while parked.
